# The Lab, by Zaid Jarrar

> A workbench of the products Zaid Jarrar has built. Every project is a specimen with a live demo or an interactive recreation, not screenshots. Zaid is a mobile and web developer who ships complete products, end to end: final-year B.Sc. Informatik student at German-Jordanian University (exchange semester at HTW Saarland), graduating May 2027, interning at Mercedes-Benz AG from October 2026, open to full-time roles from May/June 2027.

## Specimens
- [Life OS](https://lab.zaidj.tech/specimen/life-os/): Flutter and Supabase. A model reads your inbox to track job applications, tasks and subscriptions. The daily brief is built in code with no model in it, on purpose. Interactive demo.
- [Uni-Plan](https://lab.zaidj.tech/specimen/uni-plan/): React, Express and TypeScript. Checks a semester for course clashes and GPA impact before you register. Playable demo running the real conflict and GPA logic.
- [LAZ Store](https://lab.zaidj.tech/specimen/laz-store/): Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Firebase. Android app for a Tesla aftermarket parts shop Zaid ran in Jordan. Requests for parts he did not stock became potential orders for him to price and source. Interactive recreation.
- [Brewit](https://lab.zaidj.tech/specimen/brewit/): React and TypeScript. Works backwards from how you want coffee to taste to a full recipe. Work in progress, playable demo.
- [wo2go](https://lab.zaidj.tech/specimen/wo2go/): Next.js and TypeScript. Shows everywhere you can reach directly from a station. Parked while the Deutsche Bahn API it depends on is failing.
